observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage with purple and red curtain backdrop and banner for a school arts festival (CBSE State Kalolsav 2014)
observation.formation_and_space: Horizontal line across the stage, seated initially on knees and later rising to kneel or stand in place
observation.posture: Torso upright while seated or kneeling, bending forward from the waist during drumming beats
observation.footwork: Feet are mostly occluded and stationary as dancers remain kneeling or sitting on the floor for much of the sequence
observation.arms_and_hands: Both hands hold frame drums (duff) and strike them rhythmically, raising them up or bowing down to the floor
observation.hips_and_torso: Bending forward and straightening up from the waist in unison
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low level kneeling on the floor, transitioning between sitting upright and bowing forward
observation.costume_and_props: Matching white long-sleeve tunics, white trousers, and white caps; each dancer holds a circular frame drum (duff)
observation.cannot_infer: Footwork details cannot be seen as dancers remain seated or kneeling throughout the clip

signature_moments.what: Dancers bow forward together from the kneeling position until their heads and drums touch or come very close to the floor
Dancers lift drums overhead while kneeling and rhythmically strike them in unison
